hypotheses.Q1_exact_query_map: The precomputed linear query map reproduces direct shared-subspace quadratic scores with maximum relative error below 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q2_semantic_query_transfer: The full 32D map has median natural-score correlation at least 0.75 for semantic queries on all three evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.Q3_frequent_token_transfer: The full map has median correlation at least 0.50 for frequent-token unembedding queries on all three corpora.
hypotheses.Q4_language_query_advantage: On every corpus, frequent-token query correlation exceeds Gaussian-residual query correlation by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.Q5_rank128_map_compression: A rank-128 compression of the query map loses at most 0.03 semantic and 0.05 frequent-token median correlation relative to the full map on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q6_natural_write_queries: The full map has median correlation at least 0.70 for held-out natural-write PCA queries on all three corpora.
